items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: And then a guy name Armando [Peraza] came of (inaudible) in there for a while (inaudible).

ctx.x: When Vidal started the band, he got an idea, and he left (inaudible). Vidal made a (inaudible), and then he left with the band. So when Vidal left, I got (inaudible) with the band. That was my conga player, and the -- I don't remember exactly what it was. And then a guy name Armando [Peraza] came of (inaudible) in there for a while (inaudible).
How did you start getting involved with the various jazz people? Now, Gillespie was -- Dizzy was playing around -- Dizzy sat in with you, you said.
